pages.text: Something tiny was curled up behind a flowerpot outside the window. It was a kitten.
It meowed and meowed, as if it were hungry. Coco put breadcrumbs on a plate.
Mr. Pig looked out the window. "Come here!" he called in a booming voice.
The kitten jumped in fright and hid behind the pot.
"Very shy. I'll have to call louder. Come heeeere!"
The kitten hid even farther back. Only the tip of its tail showed.
Coco gently set the plate on the windowsill, then sat down farther away.
The shop was very quiet. Mr. Pig pressed both hands over his mouth too.
The kitten peeped out from behind the pot. Munch, munch. It ate the crumbs.
The plate was empty. Mr. Pig whispered very softly, "...It must have heard my voice."
